THE SUNDAY TIMES AND NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER

The unforgettable life and career of Tim Curry, the legendary star of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, IT, Clue and Spamalot, told in his own words.

From Dr. Frank-N-Furter to Pennywise, Tim Curry created some of the most iconic characters in entertainment history.

In this brilliantly entertaining memoir, Curry looks back on an extraordinary five-decade career across stage and screen. He takes us behind the scenes of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, IT, Clue and Spamalot, and shares unforgettable encounters with David Bowie, Andy Warhol, Truman Capote and more.

Witty, candid and packed with extraordinary stories, this is Tim Curry's remarkable life in his own words – and a celebration of a one-of-a-kind talent whose performances captivated generations.

“What a funny, sexy, original he was. But what I loved about him most was his heart.” Susan Sarandon

“There will only be one Tim Curry.” Luke Evans

“A prolific performer across stage, screen and TV.” The Guardian

“A superlative storyteller.” The New York Times
